item.title: WATCH: Car crashes into tattoo shop
item.description: A car reversed into the front of a tattoo parlor in Los Angeles County. Paramedics treated three people at the scene.

item.title: Iran live updates: Oil prices climb after Saudi Arabia and Strait of Hormuz strikes
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains the central flashpoint of the conflict.

item.title: Beijing responds to Anthropic CEO's call to limit China's AI growth
item.description: China's Foreign Ministry pushed back on the Anthropic chief's appeal for the U.S. to restrict China's artificial intelligence capabilities.

item.title: Iranian vessel struck in Hormuz as Houthis widen shipping lane control
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis extended their control over the strategic Bab-el-Mandeb strait as strikes continued in the Strait of Hormuz.
